escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still with real depth of field, a dark studio at night, the native layout of a vertical feed ad). GEOGRAPHY, the most important instruction: the UPPER 40% of the frame is one continuous, evenly dark, deep navy-black matte plaster studio wall with fine visible texture: no light falls on it, no glow, no bokeh, no lamps, no messages and no objects; it is calm from edge to edge. Everything lit lives between 42% and 80% of the frame height. The LOWEST 20% of the frame is the near-black matte edge of a desk right in front of the lens, crossing the whole width, completely out of focus, non-reflective, outside every light. THE MOMENT: a Latin American community lead in her late twenties, long dark hair in a low ponytail, wearing the Efeonce hoodie exactly as in its reference, stands slightly RIGHT of center, framed from the waist up, the top of her head at about 46% of the frame height, the desk edge cutting her at the waist; head almost frontal, she looks straight into the lens with a warm, attentive half-smile, holding a phone in her right hand at chest height, both arms fully visible. Behind and around her flows a wide RIVER of hundreds of small message bubbles made of light, rounded rectangles with no text, drifting from the deep left background to the right between 44% and 78% of the frame height, all dim, cool and out of focus, passing by. ONE single bubble, the one she is answering on her phone, has stopped beside her face and glows bright warm orange (#FF6500): it is the brightest element and the only key light on her face and hand; NO fill light, the far side of her face in shadow. A cool azure (#0375DB) rim light from behind outlines her hair and shoulders. Thin haze catches the river, only below 42%. The bubbles are rounded rectangles: no circles, no dots, no spheres, no rings, no emoji. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two and a half meters away at chest height, 85mm at f/2, nothing foreshortened. Fine dust, real sensor grain, genuine depth of field. Enormous contrast, deep navy blacks. No readable text, no letters, no logos of any brand.
